choices.content: If two angles are equal, then they are supplementary to the same angle.
If two angles are supplementary to each other, then the two angles are equal.
If there are two angles, then their supplementary angles are equal.
If two angles are supplementary to the same angle, then the two angles are equal.

question.prompt: Which correctly rewrites the proposition “Angles supplementary to the same angle are equal” in “if...then...” form?

solutions.explanation: The hypothesis is “two angles are supplementary to the same angle,” and the conclusion is “the two angles are equal.”
solutions.title: Separate hypothesis and conclusion
